findings.expected: Use a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png) with text translated.
findings.description: French page uses the English banner image containing English text ("Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises.").
Footer is left in English on the French page.
Uses informal tu ("Découvre tes") while the heading and rest of the site use vous.
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism; Quebec French uses "faire une demande de prêt" / "Demander un prêt".
Empty full-name validation error is in English on the French page; the other fields show "Ce champ est obligatoire."

findings.observed: Adresse e-mail / Entrez une adresse courriel valide.
findings.description: Inconsistent terms for email: label uses "e-mail" while the error uses "courriel" (the Quebec standard).

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The confirmation shows the raw template variable {montant} instead of the amount.
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates on the French page use US MM/DD/YYYY (09/15/2026, 09/12/2026, 09/08/2026), ambiguous and not the fr-CA format (YYYY-MM-DD); the due date on the same page uses ISO.
In French, zero takes the singular form.
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; French uses "solde".
A bank "statement" is a "relevé" in French; "déclaration" suggests a tax or official declaration.
The French dashboard link points to the English calculator page, switching the user to English.
The French says "Pay now", the opposite of "Pay later", and contradicts the help text about deferring the first payment.
Estimated monthly payment uses English currency format on the French page (other French amounts use "12 500,00 $").

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent en cas de remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Charges" was translated as "accusation" (legal accusation) instead of fees.

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: The French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".

findings.expected: Use a French promo image showing "Taux variable : 5,2 %" matching alt text and the rate.
findings.description: The French promo image displays a fixed rate of 4.9 %, contradicting its alt text and the page's variable rate of 5.2 %.
"Close" translated as the adjective "Proche" (near) instead of the verb "Fermer".

findings.observed: Not Found / The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: Page introuvable. L'adresse demandée n'existe pas sur le serveur.
findings.description: The 404 page under /fr/ is a generic English server error page without site chrome or French text.
